allReviewedPassages.rawText:
- scripts-red.log: 2 failures; --collect returned usage exit 2 instead of 0. The guarded archive/projection/status assertions were explicitly unmeasured until GREEN.
- scripts-edge-red.log: archive-only resume returned 3 instead of 0. Its second no-work failure was fixture interference from a deliberately pending preceding case; the cases were reordered to test no-work independently, rather than weakening the expected outcome.
- scripts-null-red.log: 1 failure; the actual null/no-work settlement was refused against its planned non-null launch path.
- scripts-partial-null-red.log: 3 failures; contradictory null/no-work with a recoverable bundle returned 0, omitted source extraction and lost discoverable findings.
- scripts-malformed-red.log: 1 failure; malformed complete-looking collection JSON was omitted from status instead of qualifying a gap.
- scripts-repair-red.log: 1 failure; repaired archive completion was globally deduplicated against an older completion, leaving the latest record gapped.
- contract-red.log: 1 failing suite with four live-tree errors: no I8 projection, no retained complete extraction, Remaining not using projection and no resume collection recovery.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Exit/collection/status boundaries: preserved inline occurrences, no empty-key acceptance, settled serial collector, no root-closing authority.
allReviewedPassages.rawText:
JSON retains `{version:1,findings:[...],gaps:[...]}`; metric-task additive fields may coexist. Check each group's `outstanding`/`deferred`, original `ref`, occurrences and supported dispositions; this task does not recompute or replace that engine. Exit 0 validates projection, 3 retains findings plus gaps, 2/4 establishes no projection. Keys alone cannot establish clean acceptance. Full source records retain known occurrences even when their archive pointer is unavailable.

New explicit preservation interface:

```bash
bash skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status --collect RUN_MD --invocation ID --workspace WORKSPACE --review FILE_OR_none --verdict REVIEW [--required RELATIVE_FILE]...
bash skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status --collect RUN_MD
```

The caller confirms settlement from persisted Launch/result, supplies the exact invocationId and actual reviewPath/null result, and preserves any declared required-input inventory. Collection returns 0 only when preservation is confirmed; 3 retains gaps and blocks later invocation/cleanup; 2/4 means no collection established. The initial intent in approvals contains invocationId/workspace/reviewPath/review/required/settled:false; settled/completion records append facts with complete/files(path,sha256)/gaps. The last record per invocation describes preservation progress only. It never closes a finding or root acceptance obligation. Archived source IDs are ID/final and ID/cluster-N; artifact pointers are reviews/ID/... relative to RUN_MD. Existing finding-route/link/disposition records are preserved.

Ordinary `report-status RUN_MD [--tip SHA] [--stalled PHASE]` keeps all legacy status forms/output where new data is absent. New records add `outstanding findings: N`, `review collections pending: N`, `review collection gaps: N`, `finding evidence gaps: N`, or an unavailable qualifier. Ordinary status exit 0 is a successfully rendered status, not an acceptance/cleanup approval: task .6 must inspect the projection, collection outcomes and its own caller-owned review/measurement/human obligations. This task deliberately adds no root-closing option or acceptance engine.

allReviewedPassages.rawText: Coordinator reports the archived paired 30-trial baseline pack (behavior-baseline/report.md, manifest/scores/raw), including F17 retention, no-change validity, source/cleanup, partial metrics and attribution composites. This supports the minimal structural consumer correction. That baseline does not establish behavior of this newly introduced collector.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Required fresh-agent post/integrated same-pack/live-isolation evaluation pending. Suggested two-resume scenario is a proposed test, not observed run.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: Representative fresh-agent post behavior evaluation is REQUIRED and remains coordinator-owned/pending, as does integrated same-pack after/live-isolation evidence. This implementer cannot spawn agents per dispatch. Deterministic RED/GREEN helper fixtures are not claimed as fresh-agent behavior verification. Recommended post scenario: I1 blocked with an active and deferred finding, I2 ready/silent, interrupted copy before completion; fresh resume twice must preserve bytes/refs/dispositions, expose I1, keep I2 separately ready and refuse cleanup for missing/partial/null-required evidence. Also cover null/no-work with no artifact and contradictory partial artifacts.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Semantic support remains agent judgment; absent optional direct input cannot be inferred, known inputs must be declared; settlement and serial run.md writes required; acceptance/metrics/sweep outside scope.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: Semantic sufficiency of a fix/rejection remains the owning agent's judgment before recording supported disposition; structural fields alone are not a semantic oracle. The collector cannot infer a missing optional direct input from absence alone, so callers must declare known required direct inputs with --required; split manifest and discovered assembled files are checked mechanically. Collection must run after confirmed settlement and serially with run.md writes, as the operative recipe specifies. Acceptance ownership, metrics and the full epic sweep remain outside this task.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Producer direct package suffix mismatch reiterated in appended fix pass, repair claimed.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: Verified the Important finding against `skills/super-code/coordinator.js` finalReviewPrompt: direct review invokes review-package with `${reviewPath}.diff`, while reviewPath defaults to `final-review-ID.md`. The collector's discovery and hasBundle checks incorrectly expected `final-review-ID.diff`. Both now recognize the actual `final-review-ID.md.diff` filename. No producer, root acceptance, measurement, metric, or disposition logic changed.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Archive and null/direct bundle regression coverage claimed, no disposition.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: The fixture now uses that producer filename. Added behavior checks prove that completion inventories it, repeated collection preserves exact bytes and records, an archive conflict returns 3 without overwriting either archive or source, and repair permits completion. A null/no-work result with only that direct package returns 3, archives the available bytes, records both reconciliation and missing-review gaps, and remains idempotently gapped on replay. Existing interrupted-copy, split-input, source-workspace-removal, immutable source/extraction, retained finding and other gap cases still pass. The new assertions catch an omitted package/inventory, incorrect complete result, overwritten source/destination bytes, lost reconciliation/missing-review gaps, or non-idempotent records; none depend on source-text matching.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Pending-behavior-eval Minor retained; post/integrated live-isolation/root acceptance/metrics parent-owned.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: The Minor pending-behavior-eval finding remains deferred to the coordinator as instructed. Fresh-agent post evaluation, integrated after/live-isolation evidence, root acceptance and metric decisions remain coordinator-owned; these deterministic tests make no claim to establish them.
